description: Backstop deny-list: endpoints that let a credentialed tab mint or register its own durable credential (or move work outside the tab with its own credential), after which it no longer needs the broker. Applied to any request the broker would inject a credential into. Bindings remain allowlist-first; this is defence in depth. Paths are matched case-insensitively against the canonical path with any trailing slash removed.

source.note: operationId and docs URL per entry come from that pinned OpenAPI description unless marked otherwise.

exceptions.reason: Copilot runtime's first call (secure-agentic spike, 2026-11-05): read-only user info, not a mint. Coordinator-approved 2026-11-05 with conditions: exact path, case-sensitive; no body, no query, no upgrade; the response must be a strict JSON object with no credential-named key and no token-shaped value anywhere, else it is blocked and audited as credential.backstop_exception_blocked (a finding). Allowlist its top-level fields once real traffic is measured. ADR 20261105-broker-model-access.

deny.reason: apps/create-from-manifest (returns an app private key and client secret) https://docs.github.com/rest/apps/apps#create-a-github-app-from-a-manifest
apps/check-token, apps/reset-token (reset mints a new token) https://docs.github.com/rest/apps/oauth-applications#reset-a-token
enterprise runner registration token; not in the api.github.com description at the pinned SHA, included as defence in depth for GHEC/GHES
enterprise runner remove token; defence in depth (see above)
enterprise JIT runner config; defence in depth (see above)
legacy OAuth Authorizations API (removed upstream; absent from the pinned description). Denied in case a GHES version still serves it
